title: What Freelance Pricing Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of freelance pricing: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Price from costs up, not fear down: know your floor (survival rate), your target (goal rate), and charge value where you can. Raise rates with proof, not apologies.

Why it matters: Floor rate = monthly costs / billable hours Most freelancers underprice by 30-50% initially

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Freelance Pricing
summary: Start freelance pricing this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Calculate monthly survival costs
2. Estimate realistic billable hours (80-100/mo)
3. Compute floor and target rates
4. Package 3 tiers: basic/standard/premium
5. Quote the middle tier first

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Common Freelance Pricing Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with freelance pricing — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Charging what employees earn hourly (no benefits math) → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Discounting without removing scope → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Free work 'for exposure' → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Apologizing for the price → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.

title: Freelance Pricing Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common freelance pricing questions.
body:
Q: How do I justify a raise?
A: Results and demand - show outcomes, cite your waitlist.

Q: Client says too expensive?
A: Offer a smaller scope, not a smaller rate.

Q: Charge for revisions?
A: Include 2 rounds; bill beyond that.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.

title: Freelance Pricing: Safety, Legal, and Fine Print

body:
